simple.meaning: בָּרָד (bârâd) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “hail.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 29 times across Exodus, Joshua, Job, Psalms, Isaiah, and 1 more, beginning at Exodus 9:18. Its contexts include land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בָּרָד (H1259).

When Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders had ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.
